response.sql: WITH rating_avgs AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) as rate_per_duration, COUNT(*) as film_count FROM film WHERE rental_duration > 5 GROUP BY rating), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate_per_duration) as bench_value FROM rating_avgs) SELECT ra.rating, ra.rate_per_duration, ra.film_count, ra.rate_per_duration / b.bench_value as normalized_rate FROM rating_avgs ra CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE b.bench_value IS NOT NULL
